200.description: Non-custodial payment capabilities including deterministic x402 V2 requirements, replay protection and facilitator preflight state

post.description: Create a seller-Passport-signed paid service offer using atomic integer units.
Bind a buyer-signed order to a one-shot capability lease and persist deterministic x402 V2 PaymentRequirements. New x402 orders require CAIP-2 network identifiers.

201.description: Service order created with stored deterministic payment requirements and digest

422.description: Lease, offer, or x402 V2 network binding mismatch

post.description: Verify an x402 V2 payment authorization using the stored deterministic PaymentRequirements. Verification requires an explicitly configured HTTPS facilitator whose /supported response advertises x402Version 2, exact scheme and the requested CAIP-2 network. Payment payload digests are reserved against cross-order replay. AccordTrace stores payer identity only as a digest and never stores raw payment payloads or wallet secrets.

409.description: Cross-order payment payload replay or legacy order without hardened requirements

502.description: Facilitator preflight or verification transport failure

503.description: x402 verification disabled, facilitator missing, or requirements unsupported

200.description: Service order and non-secret payment status
